data.title: Govt rejects reports of monthly firearm licence renewals
data.description: The government on Sunday rejected reports that gun owners would have to renew their licences and pay fees every one to two months, saying the claim was not in line with proposed measures to improve firearms control.

data.title: Thais target strong start against Japan
data.description: Thailand's women's football team are determined to put on a good performance against defending champions Japan in the first group game at the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 on Monday, said head coach Natipong Srithong-in.

data.title: Magno's late magic helps Pathum snatch first victory
data.description: BG Pathum United picked up their first win of the season when they defeated Rasisalai United 3-2 in the Thai League 1 on Saturday night.

data.title: Tensions rise over Israeli expats
data.description: Tensions have heightened in recent months over the presence of Israeli communities in various parts of the country, raising questions about nominee arrangements and land holdings involving Israelis.

data.title: TPO strikes a chord at concert in China
data.description: The Thailand Philharmonic Orchestra (TPO) has brought the sound of the Thai ranat ek to the Great Wall of China, performing alongside Western instruments at an outdoor concert in Beijing to mark the 51st anniversary of diplomatic ties between Thailand and China.

data.title: PM's Office rejects Wang Tanod forest allegation
data.description: The Prime Minister's Office has rejected claims by veteran commentator Sondhi Limthongkul that cabinet approval of the Wang Tanod reservoir in Chanthaburi amounts to ordering forest destruction.

data.title: Teacher accused of assaulting students
data.description: Parents of four boys in Ayutthaya have filed a police complaint alleging that a teacher assaulted them and threatened them with a knife after they failed to attend a school sports event.

data.title: Epac extends diesel refinery price cut policy
data.description: The Energy Policy Administration Committee (Epac) has extended a measure cutting the refinery price of high-speed diesel by 2.40 baht per litre from Wednesday to Oct 31, says the Royal Gazette.

data.title: PM instructs Ekniti to extend relief
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has told Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas to consider extending the "Thais Help Thais Plus" scheme by one to two months.

data.title: Army pledges to assist probe  into conscript's death in camp
data.description: The 2nd Army Region has pledged to cooperate fully with police and other authorities in an investigation into the death of a 20-year-old conscript found hanging from a tree at a military camp in Nakhon Ratchasima.

data.title: PP tells Pheu Thai to act on graft
data.description: People's Party (PP) deputy leader Wiroj Lakkhanaadisorn has accused Pheu Thai Party senior figure Phumtham Wechayachai of using past political disagreements as a pretext to abandon anti-corruption principles.

data.title: EC poised to show its cards
data.description: The Senate election collusion case is entering a crucial stage, with the Election Commission (EC) set to decide on Monday whether to petition the Supreme Court's Election Cases Division against those accused.

data.title: Poland, Ukraine slam Russian strikes near border as 'escalation'
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Poland and Ukraine on Sunday denounced Russian strikes close to the Polish border, including on a Warsaw-bound train and near a frontier checkpoint -- as an "escalation" in the war.

data.title: Leftwing opposition seen leading Sweden election, far-right losing ground
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Sweden's left-wing parties led in Sunday's general election, according to two exit polls published after voting ended, with the far-right seen losing ground.

data.title: Dozens arrested in major anti-LGBTQ raids in Turkey
data.description: ISTANBUL - Turkish police on Sunday swooped on gay bars and the homes of LGBTQ activists, arresting at least 60 people in raids authorities said were aimed at boosting traditional family values, officials and activists said.

data.title: Trump administration reluctant to slow AI, Democrats see urgent need
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump and key allies voiced opposition Sunday to drastically curbing the development of artificial intelligence, despite calls in recent days from leading industry figures to tap the brakes.

data.title: Trump turns to golf, family business on Irish visit's second day
data.description: DOONBEG (IRELAND) - Donald Trump turns his focus Sunday to golf and promoting his business interests, as he wraps up a two-day visit to Ireland during which his off-the-cuff diplomacy has caused another stir.

data.title: Iran's economic ties to Dubai hard to break despite war
data.description: DUBAI - In the markets of old Dubai, saffron, cumin, pistachios and almonds from Iran still fill the stalls, as if the two shores of the Gulf were not separated by war.

data.title: Macron, Carney to visit French islands after Trump's map post
data.description: PARIS - The leaders of France and Canada will next week visit France's North Atlantic territory of Saint-Pierre-and-Miquelon to underscore their support for national borders in the face of Donald Trump's territorial ambitions, Paris said Sunday.

data.title: Cafeteria ceiling collapses at costly parliament complex
data.description: A section of ceiling collapsed in a basement cafeteria at the multi-billion-baht parliament complex on Sunday, breaking tables and toppling chairs but fortunately causing no injuries because it was not a working day.

data.title: Actress links threat to her testifying about Tangmo's death
data.description: Actress Usamanee “Kwan” Waitayanon has told police she was threatened on Sunday morning, saying it might be related to her decision to give witness testimony in the death of actress Nida “Tangmo” Patcharaveerapong, who fell from a speedboat on the Chao Phraya River in 2022.

data.title: GPO reports personalised cancer vaccine use in two patients
data.description: A Thai personalised cancer vaccine course costs about 4–7 million baht a year, with public-hospital expansion proposed to make care more affordable.

data.title: Motorists warned about scam traffic-fine SMSs
data.description: Motorists are warned not to click links or scan QR codes in SMS messages claiming they have unpaid traffic fines. The messages are a scam aimed at stealing personal and financial information.

data.title: Marchers demand mass prosecutions in senate collusion case
data.description: Supporters of Internet Dialogue on Law Reform (iLaw) marched 11-kilometres through Bangkok on Sunday demanding the Election Commission submit the senate election collusion case and its 229 suspects to the Supreme Court for judgement.

data.title: Philippine rescuers pull 41 more bodies from burned ferry
data.description: CORON, Philippines - The bodies of 41 victims of the worst Philippine ferry disaster in over a decade made their way through the blue waters of a resort area on Sunday, bound for a dock where forensic investigators awaited them.

data.title: Myanmar says UN envoy illegitimate ahead of credentials decision
data.description: YANGON - Myanmar's military-backed government said Sunday their UN ambassador -- loyal to ousted leader Aung San Suu Kyi -- is occupying the office illegitimately, as the organisation prepares to weigh his replacement.

data.title: China, Russia, India seek economic cooperation at BRICS
data.description: NEW DELHI - BRICS leaders including China, Russia and India entered a second day of talks in New Delhi on Sunday, discussing "inclusive global growth", after reaching rare agreement calling for calm in the Middle East.

data.title: Hospital apologises for cutting off toddler’s finger
data.description: The management of Loengnoktha Crown Prince Hospital has apologised after an assistant nurse accidentally cut off part of a toddler's right index finger while preparing the young patient for discharge, in the northeastern province of Yasothon.

data.title: One dead, 102 rescued from stricken ferry off Indonesia's Java
data.description: JAKARTA - One person was killed and more than 100 were rescued on Sunday after a ferry sailing between the Indonesian islands of Java and Borneo was hit by bad weather, rescue officials said.

data.title: Think-tank urges EC to submit Senate case to court
data.description: Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) president Somkiat Tangkitvanich has called on the Election Commission (EC) to submit the Senate election collusion case to the Supreme Court promptly, saying it would restore public confidence.

data.description: Myanmar's military-backed ⁠government said ⁠on Sunday its ​permanent representative to the United Nations was undertaking "illegal activities" ​and that his status had ‌been revoked and withdrawn.

data.title: Ayutthaya nightclub raided, 20 customers fail drug tests
data.description: PHRA NAKHON SI AYUTTHAYA - Officials raided a popular nightclub in Uthai district early on Sunday after complaints it remained open after hours and customers were using illegal drugs. Twenty people tested positive for drug use.

data.title: Thailand faces its 2030 HIV target with youth infections still high
data.description: Thai youth aged 15-24 account for one in three new HIV infections, while stigma and unawareness of HIV status remain key barriers to the 2030 AIDS goal.

data.title: Donkoi Model turns royal guidance into jobs and modern textiles
data.description: The Donkoi Model, inspired by Princess Sirivannavari’s guidance, turns Sakon Nakhon weaving into modern fashion, jobs and Asian Games attire.

data.title: Forecast is for widespread heavy rain
data.description: Heavy to very heavy rain is forecast for 42 provinces and Bangkok throughout Sunday into Monday, with flash-flood, forest runoff and landslides warnings in vulnerable areas.

data.title: Poll respondents demand Israeli visitors obey Thai laws
data.description: An opinion survey found most respondents were aware of behavioural issues among some Israeli people in Thailand and support strict law enforcement as a solution.
